paper_title: First search for dark photon dark matter with a MADMAX prototype
notes: First dark photon DM search with a MADMAX dielectric haloscope prototype (3 sapphire disks + mirror). 95% CL exclusion of chi > 2.7e-12 over full mass range 78.62-83.95 ueV, with peak sensitivity chi = 1.1e-13 at 80.57 ueV (booster resonance at 19.48 GHz). Full frequency-dependent limit shown in Fig. 4 but only these anchor values are quoted numerically in text; emitted points are the flat envelope endpoints plus the resonant dip. Assumes unpolarized DPDM with rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 3))
